By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Tactical Effects division (TFX) has two missions: 1) build highly capable and reliable autonomous drones, 2) deliver at scale to meet the needs of the warfighter. We transform products like Ghost, Anvil, and Bolt from early concepts into fully operational capabilities by partnering closely with specialist engineering, operations, and production teams.

TFX hires engineers who are passionate about rapid prototyping and scalability to a full-fledged product line. We are excited to build across a diverse and powerful portfolio-from autonomous aerial systems to high-performance imaging payloads and launchers that operate reliably in the most demanding mission environments.

Do you like designing things that fly fast, sometimes explode, and make a big (literal and figurative) impact on our world events? title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Thurgau
description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Thurgau dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

description:

•
Monatliches Kosten-Screening & BWA-Aufbereitung: Detaillierte Analyse der Kostenpositionen und proaktives Aufzeigen von Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.

•
Stakeholder-Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales (Provisionsberechnungen im CRM), Marketing (Tracking & Budgetfreigaben), Product (Produktmetriken) und Customer Success (Churn-Analyse).

•
Accounting- & Controlling-Optimierung: Enger Austausch mit dem Buchhaltungsteam, Prozessoptimierung und Prüfung gebuchter Positionen.

Koordination von Banken & Versicherungen: Verwaltung mehrerer Bankkonten und regelmäßige Prüfung von Anlagen (Tagesgeld, Versicherungen etc.).

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
About the role
At Moniepoint , as an Analytics Manager, you will use data to make better decisions, faster for the business. You will own metrics, measurement, experimentation and the analysis/data roadmap for a business area. You’ll use data to quantify business KPIs and conduct analyses to uncover unknowns, helping the business unit achieve its goals for acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue. As a leader of the business unit, the role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and growth.
What you’ll do

• Strategic Leadership: Build a disciplined, exceptional analytical team. Develop and execute a comprehensive data and analytics roadmap and strategy

• Team Building & Management: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of analytics professionals

• Data Insights & Analytics - including forecast building, business analysis and model development and productionisation. Drive the generation of actionable insights from data to support various business functions, including product, operations, marketing and engineering. What is our actual CAC per channel? Which customer segments are more/less engaged? What are our customers’ share of wallet - how can we use this? What is the typical behaviour of a Moniepoint consumer? What products cause the biggest incremental engagement?

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with growth, product, and engineering managers to ensure we collect the right data for meaningful business insights. Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development. Build a strategic understanding of the business and structure complex projects to bring them to life.

Business: Growth

• Create and maintain the yearly forecast and budget for your products.

title: Growth Product Manager - e-Commerce (m/f/d)
description:
We're hiring a growth Product Manager to own the buyer side of InPost 's ecommerce marketplace - acquisition, activation, retention.
Millions of people in Europe already receive parcels through InPost . Far fewer of them start their shopping with us. Closing that gap is the job. You'll own the buyer funnel end to end: how we communicate the USP, how first-time buyers get onboarded, what makes them come back for a second order, and where they drop off in between.
This is an experimentation role, not a spec-writing role. You'll run a high-velocity test pipeline with engineering, design and data, and use what you learn to argue for bigger bets. You'll also work inside a two-sided marketplace, so buyer-side wins have to hold up against seller-side incentives - that tension is part of the work, not a distraction from it.
What you'll do:

• Own activation, conversion and retention metrics for the buyer funnel including the targets.

• Run experimentation as a pipeline: hypothesis, sizing, test, analysis, rollout or kill. Weekly cadence, not quarterly.

• Hunt friction across USP communication, awareness, activation, engagement, discovery and onboarding and remove it.

• Turn funnel analysis into roadmap bets, and build the case for the expensive ones with evidence.

• Work directly with marketing and commercial teams on demand generation and offer mechanics..

• Balance buyer incentives against seller economics, and be explicit about the trade-off you're making.

• Ship, measure, and say out loud when something didn't work.

What you'll need

• 3+ years in product management, ideally growth, marketplace or ecommerce.

• Real experience running experiments - you can explain how you sized a test, what you did about an inconclusive result, and a hypothesis of yours that turned out to be wrong.

• Fluency in funnel analytics. You pull your own numbers and don't outsource your judgement to a dashboard.

• A working model of two-sided marketplace dynamics.

• Bias toward shipping and measuring over perfecting.

• Experience where growth work is close to commercial operations, not just to marketing.

• Ability to hold a position with stakeholders when the data supports it.

• Polish and English, fluent.

Not a fit if

• You want a stable roadmap defined by someone else.

• You measure your impact in features shipped.

• You'd rather run one perfect launch than twenty imperfect tests.

What we offer

• A funnel with millions of users at the top of it and clear room to improve.

• Ownership of metrics, budget-relevant decisions and the roadmap for your area.

• Engineering, design and analytics partners you work with directly, not through a queue.

• Access to challenging projects and innovative technologies.

• B2B contract, remote within Poland, flexible hours.

InPost has revolutionised e-commerce parcel delivery in Poland and is now one of Europe’s leading out-of-home (OOH) e-commerce enablement platforms. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska, InPost provides delivery services through a network of over 64,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) points across nine European countries: Poland, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, alongside to-door courier and fulfilment services for ecommerce merchants.
InPost ’s extensive OOH network supports rapidly growing parcel volumes across its markets, with 1.4 billion parcels delivered in 2025. Its locker solutions offer consumers a delivery option that is cheaper, more flexible and convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless. As a leading OOH logistics provider, InPost is recognized for transforming parcel delivery economics in Europe, appealing to both consumers and merchants through its flexible, technology-driven solutions.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Who we are

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As Principal Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will be the most senior individual contributor on a team of about fifteen engineers, setting the technical direction for the product and leading its largest, most consequential projects from idea to customer.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will shape that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a technical leadership role, not a management role. You will work directly with engineering and product leaders to form the roadmap, then lead engineers across sub-teams to execute it. You will stay hands-on: you write and review code every week, and the hardest problems land on your desk first.

What the team owns

• Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).

• The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.

• Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.

• Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

• Set the technical direction for Chainguard Containers: the architecture of the build pipeline, the registry, and the adoption tooling over the next one to three years, written down and defended in the open.

• Form the roadmap with engineering and product leaders, then execute it. Turn ambiguous business goals into sequenced, staffed technical plans, and own the delivery of the largest multi-team projects from concept through production and adoption.

• Make and own the trade-offs that shape the product: build versus buy, when to re-platform and when not to, what to cut to hit a date. Write the decision down and bring dissenting engineers along.

• Lead through other engineers. Set the design bar, review the designs and code that matter most, and grow the Staff and

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
WHAT WE'RE BUILDING

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer - providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

 

WHY JOIN SHADOW?

- Product Ownership You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.

- Shape the Engineering Culture You'll influence how we work-tools, processes, standards, and hiring.

- Work with Challenger Consumer Brands Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands-some doing $80M-$500M in revenue.

 

THE AGENCY BEHIND THE PRODUCT

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom - a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one - not a synthetic demo.

 

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM-5 PM EST).

 

THE ROLE

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

 

Core Tech & Tools

- Languages & Frameworks: Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)

- Datastore: PostgreSQL

- Cloud & Infra: Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

- ML/AI: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.

- Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.

- Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.

- Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.

- Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.

- Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.

- Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.

- Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.

- Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

 

MUST HAVES

- Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.

- Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.

- Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.

- Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.

- A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.

- Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.

- Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.

- Daily use of AI tools like Cursor

description:
About Us

InStride Health ’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

Team InStride Health : Our Core Values

•
Give Heart : We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.

•
Work Smart : We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.

•
Have Humility : We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.

•
Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role
We are seeking a Billing Coordinator to support front-end and back-end billing operations across our fully virtual care delivery model. This role plays an important part in supporting a seamless and compliant revenue cycle by helping ensure services are accurately documented, charges are entered on time, and insurance claims are submitted, tracked, and resolved efficiently. The Billing Coordinator will support key billing activities including charge entry, claims submission and follow-up, denial resolution, patient billing, and accounts receivable monitoring. With guidance and partnership from senior team members, this role will assist in identifying patterns related to billing errors and denials and contribute to efforts aimed at improving clean claim rates, reimbursement outcomes, and overall billing accuracy.
This role requires close collaboration and strong communication skills to build effective working relationships with care team members, cross-functional partners, families, and external stakeholders. The Billing Coordinator also serves as a supportive point of contact for families navigating insurance and billing questions, balancing technical knowledge with empathy and clear communication.
Responsibilities:

• Review clinical documentation to support accurate and timely charge entry in the billing system in accordance with payor requirements.

• Assist with monitoring for missing or delayed charges and support timely submission within payor filing limits.

• Submit insurance claims and monitor claim status to help ensure compliance with payor-specific guidelines.

• Assist in identifying and correcting claim errors, rejections, and denials to support a clean and efficient billing cycle.

• Support denial resolution activities, including investigation, correction, resubmission, and follow-up, with guidance as needed.

• Help identify billing denial trends and contribute observations to senior team members to support improvements in clean claim rates and reimbursement outcomes.

• Serve as a billing point of contact for families, explaining insurance processing, copays, deductibles, and balances with empathy and clarity.

• Assist with self-pay billing, patient statement cycles, and individualized payment plans.

• Support accounts receivable monitoring through reporting, reconciliation, and audit-related activities.

• Use billing and financial reports to help manage daily workflows and prioritize follow-up tasks.

• Partner with Patient Experience, Authorization & Eligibility, and clinical teams to help resolve coverage questions and support billing education.

• Maintain accurate patient accounting records while adhering to HIPAA

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

Essentiel :

- Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément.

- Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à :

title: Application Scientist
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.

YOUR IMPACT

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.

APPLICATION AREAS

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

- Electronics: Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

- Energy: Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

- Environment: Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

- Cross-cutting: Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

PROJECT LEADERSHIP AND DELIVERY

- Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

- Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

- Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.

SCIENCE AND CAMPAIGNS

- Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

- Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

- Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.

BRIDGING EXPERIMENTAL AND COMPUTATIONAL TEAMS

- Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

- Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

- Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.

CAPABILITY AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

- Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

title: Designer, Brand and Growth
description:
Salary range: $90K to $110K, plus equity
About Badge

Mobile wallets now account for roughly as many in-store purchases as cash, and unlike cash, they're still climbing. Most brands still treat them as a place to store a card.

Badge is the infrastructure that changes that. We give enterprise brands and platforms one integration to issue and operate passes and cards across Apple, Google, and Samsung Wallet. Loyalty cards, stored value, memberships, IDs, and tickets, all living on the surface customers already carry, updating in real time, with no app download and no new account.
The platform meets teams wherever they work: a no-code UI for marketers, flexible APIs for developers, an embed SDK for platform partners, and an MCP server so AI agents can build on it directly. That powers in-wallet push notifications, location-based messages, offers, tap-to-redeem, and more.
We are a fast-growing team backed by leading investors including TTV Capital, Stripe, Synchrony Ventures, and Infinity Ventures, and trusted by companies like Hoka, Blackhawk Network, Shift4, and Yale University. We value sharp thinking, fast execution, and a real understanding of how customers behave in a mobile-first world.

Position overview
Join Badge as a Brand and Growth Designer to shape how the world sees and experiences Badge . You'll own design for our growth marketing, including the website, content, social, email, and sales materials. You'll also work closely with product to deepen knowledge and accuracy across the Badge product suite.
This role is a great fit for a versatile designer who loves ownership, moves quickly between brand and sales enablement, and gets energized when their work drives pipeline, closes deals, and helps customers succeed.
Questions we're exploring
* How do we make mobile wallets feel like an obvious, must-have channel to enterprise marketers who haven't thought about them before?
* How do we speak to three different audiences (marketers, developers, and platform partners) without our story fragmenting?
* How do we show wallet experiences like push notifications, location-based offers, and tap-to-redeem in ways that are visual and easy to understand?
* How do we give sales and marketing a template system they can use on their own while keeping the brand consistent?
* How can the marketing site and the product feel like one connected experience, from first visit to first pass created?
Core Responsibilities

• Orchestrate the Badge website. Design, build, and iterate on trybadge.com in Webflow in collaboration with agencies and leadership as needed. Website design includes landing pages, product and solution pages, and campaign/event pages. Work with marketing to test and improve what converts.

• Enable sales and leadership. Build and refine sales decks, one-pagers, customer case studies, and executive and investor presentations, and maintain a template library the team can use on their own.

• Power content and social. Create blog visuals, product diagrams, and LinkedIn assets (posts, carousels, event and launch graphics) that make wallet experiences easy to understand.

• Bring Badge to life at events. Design conference and event collateral, booth graphics, signage, and swag that make Badge stand out in person.

• Build email that scales. Design reusable email templates for newsletters, product updates, and nurture campaigns.

• Build systems, not one-offs. Maintain and evolve Badge 's visual identity across every touchpoint, and contribute to our design system, brand guidelines, and scalable templates, so every new asset is faster to make and stays consistent.

• Design with AI. Use tools like Claude, Figma AI, and other emerging tools to explore concepts, speed up production, and prototype. AI helps you move faster; your judgment and craft decide what ships.

• Collaborate across the team. Work with marketing, sales, product, and engineering to understand goals, give and get feedback, and ship work that moves the business.

title: Privacy Specialist
description:
Description
WHO WE ARE
Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera ’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely - deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

Cyera is seeking a Privacy Specialist to help us win and expand our privacy line of business. This is a technical, customer-facing go-to-market role that supports our sales organization. You will be the privacy expert in the room alongside our Account Executives and Sales Engineers, turning a prospect's privacy requirements into compelling, credible demonstrations, proofs of value, and RFP responses that help our sellers move deals forward. You will work in front of prospects and customers across the full suite of privacy capabilities, including data subject requests, data mapping, privacy assessments, risk management, and consent and preference management.
To be clear about what this is: a technical, external-facing role that supports our sales team, not an in-house privacy or compliance role. Your privacy expertise matters because it helps our sellers win. You will be equally comfortable presenting to executive privacy leaders and to hands-on technologists and operators, building tailored demos, and writing RFP responses that stand out. You will be a key player in how Cyera sells privacy, and your insight from the field will shape the product. We're an AI-forward team, and the strongest candidates will show us how they use AI to work smarter and how they'd help customers navigate the intersection of AI, privacy, and data security.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Field Engagement

• Serve as the privacy subject matter expert for sales and solutions teams, joining discovery calls, demos, and executive briefings with prospects and customers.

• Build and deliver tailored demos that connect Cyera 's privacy capabilities to each customer's regulatory drivers, operating model, and existing use cases.

• Lead proof of value engagements from scoping through customer readout, including success criteria, tenant and environment setup with the account team, and aligning product capabilities to customer use cases.

• Own privacy responses to RFPs, RFIs, and related questionnaires, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely answers and coordinating input from internal teams.

Pre-Sales Support

• Run the privacy demo request process, including intake, prep documentation, agendas, and engaging the right SMEs for each call.

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact on active pursuits, POVs, and RFPs.

• Hand off cleanly to Customer Success and Implementation teams so customers move smoothly from sale to deployment.

Product and Technical Expertise

• Act as a power user of the privacy products, with working knowledge of its modules, integrations, and configuration, so you can demo and troubleshoot with confidence.

• Capture structured customer feedback, feature gaps, and win and loss insights, and relay them to the Product team to influence the roadmap.

GTM Enablement

• Develop demo scripts, talk tracks, and recorded walkthroughs across the full suite of privacy capabilities.

• Enable and certify technical teams to present privacy modules with confidence.

• Work with Product Marketing to turn field learnings into positioning, collateral, and customer stories.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Deploy 
 
Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughout.  Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Trusted by the world's largest and most innovative organizations, Deploy's solutions unlock high-performance AI model inference at production scale.

Deploy has raised more than $200M from leading investors, including Tomales Bay Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. The company has more than 250 employees across offices in San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and Delhi.
 
Chief of Staff Role 
 
We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Chief of Staff to work closely with our executive team to help streamline our productivity and oversee critical internal operations. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in a business management or administrative role, with a focus on executive-level advising and interdepartmental collaboration. You will act as a liaison by managing staff, attending meetings and company functions, and communicating on behalf of our executive team. You’ll be wearing many different hats, so if you’re quick on your feet and are willing to take on any challenge, big or small, this is the job for you! 

Who We Are 
 
We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Deploy, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company. 
 
Thank you for your interest in Deploy and we hope to meet you soon!
 
The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $90,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. title: Mechanical Engineer - Equipment Engineering

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

- Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

- Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

- Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Design and build the machines, fixtures, and tooling used to manufacture HTS magnet coils.

Develop the manufacturing processes that turn new equipment into a repeatable production line.

Work hands-on with technicians to build, debug, and commission equipment on the shop floor.

Own equipment and process development together, from clean-slate concept through production readiness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design new manufacturing equipment and fixtures for magnet manufacturing; from concept generation and trade studies through the whole equipment life cycle.

Perform proof-of-concept calculations, benchtop testing, and tolerance stack-up analysis to validate design decisions before committing to build.

Own subsystem designs, BOMs (Bills of Materials), specifications, and drawings, and manage changes as designs mature.

Develop, coordinate and document assembly procedures, commissioning and operation for the equipment you design.

Support technicians during equipment build, assembly, and commissioning.

Supporting the production team troubleshooting issues and iterating on design or process as needed.

Drive non-conformances to root cause and turn findings into concrete process or design improvements.

Provide DFM (Design for Manufacturing)/DFA (Design for Assembly) input to magnet design engineers to keep coil designs manufacturable.

Select and manage external vendors and machine shops for components, subassemblies, and fabricated parts.

Recommend equipment, tooling, or facility improvements needed to scale manufacturing capacity as production ramps.

Participate in design reviews, and communicate design and process decisions clearly to cross-functional partners.

WHO YOU ARE

title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager who can pick up any Baseten product and explain it clearly to the people who buy it. Baseten sells dedicated inference, Model APIs, training and post-training, and the enterprise platform that ties them together. The work behind each one is the same: understand how the product works, know where it stands against the alternatives, and write about it well enough that an ML engineer trusts it and a buyer acts on it.

We’re hiring for this role across multiple product lines. You’ll work on whichever launch, narrative, or competitive gap matters most at the time, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and the rest of product marketing. It’s a good fit for someone who ramps on technical products quickly and wants to be the person who figures out the story.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Positioning & Technical Narrative

- Own positioning and messaging for Baseten products across inference, Model APIs, training and post-training, and the core platform, written for ML engineers, platform teams, and executive buyers.

- Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand architecture, tradeoffs, and roadmap, and make sure every technical claim is accurate and backed by how the product actually behaves.

- Keep product-level messaging consistent with Baseten’s platform narrative so each product story supports the others.

- Write messaging that is technically credible without getting lost in implementation detail.

Launches & Go-to-Market

- Build and run launch plans for new products and major capabilities, from internal enablement through external announcement.

- Decide what deserves a full launch and what should ship through docs, sales enablement, or targeted customer outreach.

- Create launch assets including messaging briefs, landing pages, technical blog posts, demo storylines, sales decks, one-pagers, and FAQs.

- Partner with Demand Gen, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Marketing to turn product capabilities into campaigns and deal support.

Competitive & Market Insight

- Track the competitive landscape across inference providers, model API companies, hyperscalers, and internal DIY platforms, including pricing, packaging, launches, and messaging.

- Turn that analysis into a clear point of view on where Baseten wins and loses, and use it to sharpen positioning.

- Talk to customers and sellers to understand buying criteria, objections, and deal blockers, and bring what you learn back to Product and Marketing as concrete recommendations.

Sales Enablement

- Build battlecards, competitive talk tracks, objection-handling guides, and product training that sellers actually use.

- Work with Sales and Solutions to find enablement gaps and close them.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 4+ years in product marketing, technical marketing, or developer marketing, with at least 2 of those years marketing to developers or technical buyers at an infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, data, or AI company.

- Strong writing. You can take a dense technical topic and make it clear without oversimplifying it, and you have samples to show.

- Technical fluency. You’re comfortable reading docs, asking engineers specific questions, and getting up to speed on concepts like inference, autoscaling, fine-tuning, and open- vs. closed-weight models.

- Hands-on competitive analysis experienc

title: Operations Manager- Member Experience
description:
Position summary
The Operations Manager, Member Experience supports the overall operations of VIVIO's Member Experience organization and issue resolution and quality. In this client-facing role, the manager works directly with clients, consultants and vendors on member-facing issues, owning each from first notice to final resolution:
We are looking for a strong root cause analyst who looks past individual complaints to find and fix the underlying process, system, policy or training gap. Member issue resolution, quality and AI tool oversight are the core focus, but the role supports Member Experience operations wherever the business needs it as VIVIO grows.
Key responsibilities
Client, Consultant and Vendor Partnership

• Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, consultants and vendors on member-facing issues, owning communication from intake to resolution with clear, proactive updates.

• Lead issue review calls and deliver written resolution summaries covering timeline, member impact, root cause, corrective actions and follow-up commitments.

• Handle difficult conversations with composure and empathy, balancing partner expectations with contract terms, regulatory requirements and operational realities.

• Build trusted relationships and present issue trends, quality results and improvements in client and consultant business reviews.

Member Issue Resolution and Escalations

• Prioritize member-facing issues by urgency and impact to minimize medication delays, and serve as the final internal escalation point for complex member, pharmacy, prescriber and payer issues.

• Coordinate with providers, pharmacies, vendors and internal teams to resolve cases and confirm the member outcome before closure.

• Maintain intake, triage, SLA and documentation standards, and streamline workflows that delay medication fills or other member services.

• Track KPIs (volume, time to resolution, SLA adherence, repeat issues, satisfaction) and audit case handling to drive improvement plans.

Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement

• Lead structured root cause analysis on issues, escalations, complaints, quality failures and incidents using methods such as 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, Pareto analysis and process mapping.

Quality and Compliance

AI Tool Oversight

• Serve as the team's expert on VIVIO's AI tool and coach staff on using it well.

• Review AI-assisted interactions for accuracy and compliance, partner with technology to improve the tool, and identify automation opportunities that reduce repeat issues and strengthen quality.

Leadership, Reporting and Collaboration

title: 2027 Spring - Packaging Engineer Co-op (Jan - July 2027)
description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

Help fans discover-and rediscover-the brands they love.

Bring your curiosity, ideas and point of view to a team creating products, games and experiences enjoyed by fans around the world.

About Hasbro

Hasbro creates joy and community through the magic of play. Across Hasbro, Wizards of the Coast and our partner network, teams bring iconic brands and new ideas to life through games, toys, entertainment and experiences.

About the role

In this role, you will support packaging development across Hasbro’s toy and game portfolio, with the chance to work on brands such as Nerf, Play-Doh, Star Wars, Transformers and Marvel. You will use ArtiosCAD to design and develop dielines and work with a cross-functional team to evaluate cost and help deliver projects on time.

What you’ll do

• Design packages that consider perceived value, aesthetic appeal and branding direction throughout the product development cycle.

• Develop packaging concepts through brainstorms and sketches for toys and games.

• Create 2D and 3D CAD files for cost effective, sustainable and creative packaging.

• Create detailed packaging specifications and bills of materials.

• Prototype fully assembled packaging, including packaging whites and blisters.

• Work with cross-functional partners to evaluate cost and keep projects on schedule.

What you bring

• You are currently enrolled in a university degree program in Packaging, Industrial Design, Graphic Design, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

• Creative and conceptual thinking, problem-solving and attention to detail.

• Ability to brainstorm package concepts and explain them through sketches and conversation.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset.

• Openness to improvement through personal goals and constructive feedback.

• Knowledge of 2D and 3D CAD in ArtiosCAD and SolidWorks.

• Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop is a plus.

Work samples: No portfolio is required. You may share sketches, CAD files, or a class, club, work or personal project that shows how you approach design problems.

Who can apply

• You are currently enrolled in an accredited university degree program and will remain enrolled for at least one academic term after completing the co-op. Previous graduates are not eligible.

• You can commit to the full program schedule and work model.

• You meet the work-authorization requirements stated below.

Listed majors are examples. Related programs, coursework and transferable projects are welcome; previous internship or co-op experience is not required. If you do not match every preferred skill, we still encourage you to apply.

Opportunity details

• Co-op start and end dates: January - July 2027

• Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

• Work model: Hybrid

• Location: Boston, MA

• Application deadline: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, as needed.

Pay and benefits

This is a paid co-op. Hourly rates vary by degree level and year in school.

• Boston hourly rate: $31 - $35

• Our Early Careers team reviews applications.

• Selected candidates will interview with the hiring team.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The Company is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

title: Account Partner, Large Pro Partnerships
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Large Pro Partnership team at Angi manages our largest partners in the home services industry. This is a high-visibility, high-impact team responsible for millions of dollars in revenue and a pivotal role in the company's growth. We operate as trusted advisors to our partners - not vendors - and the relationships we build directly shape how the industry's largest service professionals grow their businesses.

What you’ll do:

Angi is seeking an Account Partner, Large Pro Partnerships to grow and retain revenue across a portfolio of enterprise service professional partners, ranging from mid-size regional businesses to national, private equity-backed accounts. You will serve as the primary strategic advisor and executive-level point of contact for your partners - helping them maximize their outcomes on the Angi platform through business insight, strategic planning, and a consultative approach rooted in genuine relationship depth.

This is a portfolio management role, not a feature adoption role. You are not here to walk partners through a product checklist - you are here to understand their business, translate performance data into actionable strategy, and serve as the person their VP or C-suite calls when they want to think through what's working and what's next.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defending a partnership through a difficult retention conversation and proactively building the case for growth. You hold both outcomes - and you know the difference between when to stabilize and when to push.

Strategic Account Ownership

- Manage a portfolio of enterprise service professional partners as their primary point of contact and strategic advisor

- Own both retention and revenue growth across your portfolio

- Build trusted, durable relationships with partner leadership - VPs, C-suite executives, and owners - grounded in business credibility, not just rapport

- Lead regular executive business reviews that deliver meaningful performance insight, strategic recommendations, and a clear point of view - not just reporting

- Conduct ongoing discovery to understand each partner's business evolution, competitive pressures, and growth priorities

- Serve as the primary escalation point for partner issues, driving cross-functional resolution and maintaining transparent communication throughout

- Collaborate with partners on marketing strategies and platform investments that are tied to their specific growth goals

Data-Driven Partner Strategy

- Analyze partner performance metrics - including appointment set rates, cost of marketing, close rates, and spend trajectory - to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

- Translate complex data into clear narratives and action plans that resonate with executive-level audiences, not just operators

- Build and maintain forecasts across key account metrics including funnel performance, seasonal trends, and spend pacing

- Recommend and implement account adjustments - coverage areas, spend targets, communication structures - based on data, not just partner requests

Growth & Revenue Expansion

- Proactively identify expansion opportunities tailored to each partner's business model and growth stage - don't wait to be asked

- Build ROI-based business cases for increased platform investment that a CMO, CFO or COO would find cred

title: Enterprise Strategy Manager
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Enterprise Strategy Manager to join our Montreal team at Lightspeed. This role will support enterprise and business strategy efforts by conducting analysis, developing insights, and helping teams make data-driven decisions. As Lightspeed enters its next phase of growth and a multi-year transformation, this role will help shape and support key strategic priorities across the business. The ideal candidate brings strong strategic thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll be doing:

- Support enterprise and business strategy efforts through research, analysis, and insight development, including contributing to annual strategic planning and ongoing strategic review cadences

- Break down complex business problems and conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis

- Build models, synthesize data, and develop materials to support executive-level decision-making

- Contribute to the development of business cases, plans, and recommendations

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather inputs and support the execution of key initiatives

- Help track progress and performance of initiatives against key milestones and targets

What you need to bring:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail

- Ability to structure problems and work through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

- Comfort working with data and translating findings into clear insights

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions

- Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and take ownership

- As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

- 3-5 years of experience in consulting, strategy, finance, or a related field

- Experience working on structured problem-solving engagements (e.g., strategy, operations, or transformation projects)

- Internship or early-career experience involving data analysis and business problem solving

- Experience in SaaS, fintech, or other technology-driven environments

You’ll enjoy:

- A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

- The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

- Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.
